name: fightstick-viewer
description: Fighting game controller viewer for OBS

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:electron && npm run build:editor && npm run build:viewer
scripts.stop: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const pidFile = path.join(__dirname, 'server.pid'); if (fs.existsSync(pidFile)) { const pid = fs.readFileSync(pidFile, 'utf8'); try { process.kill(parseInt(pid), 'SIGTERM'); console.log('Server stopped (PID: ' + pid + ')'); } catch (e) { console.log('Server not running'); } if (fs.existsSync(pidFile)) { fs.unlinkSync(pidFile); } } else { console.log('Server not running (no PID file)'); }"
